optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Software Quality Engineer, Insurance Claims Platform

professionalSummary.text: Software Quality Engineer with 3 years of experience on the claims platform, specializing in regression suite development, defect triage, and release test documentation.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included regression suite development, defect triage, scope proposals and release test summaries for the claims platform over about three years as one of four quality engineers.

experienceHighlights.text: Designed and maintained the automated regression suite for the claims-handling application (Java, Selenium, REST-assured), covering claim intake, reserve changes, and payment authorization flows, with nightly pipeline execution.
experienceHighlights.witness: Designed and maintained the automated regression suite for the claims-handling application (Java, Selenium and REST-assured), covering claim intake, reserve changes and payment authorisation flows, and kept it running nightly in the pipeline.

experienceHighlights.text: Reproduced and triaged defects from regression runs and claims operations' acceptance sessions, documenting steps, environment, and root cause in the defect tracker.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reproduced and triaged defects from the regression runs and from claims operations' acceptance sessions, recording steps, environment and root cause in the defect tracker.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote release test summaries documenting known limitations (e.g., payment flows for reinsured claims not automated) and hand-over notes for the support team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the release test summary for each release, listing known limitations of the suite (payment flows for reinsured claims were not automated) and the hand-over notes for the support team.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Regression suite coverage map and release test summary with pipeline run identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the regression suite's coverage map and one release test summary, with the pipeline run identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Java, Selenium, REST-assured, defect tracking, release documentation.
skills.witness: Designed and maintained the automated regression suite for the claims-handling application (Java, Selenium and REST-assured), covering claim intake, reserve changes and payment authorisation flows, and kept it running nightly in the pipeline.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in regression suite development, defect triage, scope proposals, and release documentation. However, they do not establish that the candidate held the quality sign-off that gates production, as the QA lead was responsible for that.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's role in the quality sign-off process is ambiguous; human review is required to clarify who held the production gate.
